is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii in central Côte d'Ivoire (Page 1-2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports Vgsc L1014F (L995F), Vgsc L1014S (L995S), Vgsc N1575Y (N1570Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (Page 2, Table 5, Figure 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 provides extractable genotype counts (LL, LF, FF for 1014F and NN, NY, YY for 1575Y) and sample sizes per village. Text states 367 samples were screened for 1014S (all wild-type).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from 8 study villages in central Côte d'Ivoire between September and November 2016 and reared to adulthood for testing (Page 8).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting baseline field vector monitoring data (Page 2, 8).

sub_country_location.evidence: Eight specific study villages (Akanzakro, Kologonouan, Konzo, Kouakro, N'Guessan Pokoukro, Saoundi, Seoule, Sessenouan) in central Côte d'Ivoire are reported with exact geographic coordinates in Table 6 (Page 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae collections took place between September 2016 and November 2016 (Page 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: New empirical baseline study data collected specifically for a cluster randomized controlled trial evaluation in central Côte d'Ivoire.

supplement.evidence: Extractable target-site genotype counts, species composition, and sample sizes are provided in tables in the main text (Table 4 and Table 5).

assessment.summary: This primary field study evaluated insecticide resistance status, target-site resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc 1014F, 1014S, 1575Y and Ace-1 G119S), and metabolic expression profiles in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii populations across eight villages in central Côte d'Ivoire during late 2016.
